QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Stranger in a Strange Land
QuestInfo.1: As you began your battle with Nobunaga to rescue Princess Sakuno, a burst of light knocked you unconscious. It seemed as if someone was speaking to you...
QuestInfo.2: Yamanaka Yukimori, a young warrior that was in the battle at Honnou-ji, rescued you. Maybe he will know what's happening.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 621\nCan proceed to the Picking up the Pieces quest

0.0: Where am I? Where is the princess? Where is the Mist Cutter?!
0.1: Shattered... Nobunaga destroyed everything I had.
0.2: This is no time for moping. I must remember my training. There was the battle, and a flash of light...
0.3: And now this unfamiliar place. I do not see the walls of Honnou-ji, the fires of battle. I swear there was a voice. I'd better look around.

no.0: No. I will stay here and return to my thoughts.

1.0: Are you all right? You were out for a minute there.You look surprised.Your injuries seemed light. Give yourself a moment to become acclimated, and you will be fine.
